reference_provenance.readme_entry: black-scholes (cuda) -> Bundesbank/FinanceBench lineage, analytic engine ported from QuantLib; upstream license: HeCBench BSD-3-Clause (Argonne National Laboratory, Zheming Jin)

algorithm: Black-Scholes analytic engine (QuantLib port); 37 pinned settings streamed as settings[i mod 37]
timing_scope: per kernel launch, end-to-end on queue; median of samples after 1 warm-up; comparable to reference 'Average kernel execution time on GPU'
validation: independent double-precision std::erfc oracle; NaN/Inf rejected; abs tolerance 1.0e-4 (= reference's own published-price tolerance)

rows.note: single-thread sanity point, not a competitive baseline

reference_commands.cuda: nvcc -std=c++17 -Xcompiler -Wall -arch=sm_70 -O3 src/black-scholes-cuda/blackScholesAnalyticEngine.cu -o blackscholes_cuda_ref; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ./blackscholes_cuda_ref 100  # prints 'Average kernel execution time on GPU'
reference_commands.cpu: cd src/black-scholes-omp && g++ -O2 -fopenmp -std=c++17 -I. -include blackScholesAnalyticEngineStructs.h -include cfloat ref_cpu_main.cpp blackScholesAnalyticEngineKernelsCpu.cpp -o blackscholes_cpu_ref; OMP_NUM_THREADS=48 ./blackscholes_cpu_ref 1  # calls reference getOutValOptionCpu in an OpenMP for

repro_commands.cpu: cmake --preset rel-host-cpu-gcc -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON . && cmake --build build/rel-host-cpu-gcc --target black-scholes_alpaka -j && OMP_NUM_THREADS=48 ./build/rel-host-cpu-gcc/benchmark/black-scholes/black-scholes_alpaka --options 50000000 --repeat 100 --samples 5
repro_commands.cuda: export PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.6/bin:$PATH CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.6; cmake --preset rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=70 -Dalpaka_COMPILE_PEDANTIC=ON . && cmake --build build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc --target black-scholes_alpaka -j && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ./build/rel-cuda-nvcc-gcc/benchmark/black-scholes/black-scholes_alpaka --options 50000000 --repeat 100 --samples 5
